headline: Treasury Secretary Bessent questioned whether Nvidia 'goosed' earnings with suspect China chip sales, as Congress moved to tighten AI chip export rules and a new report warned space data centers could end stargazing.

points.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent questioned whether Nvidia's earnings might have been inflated by inappropriate sales to China and urged the company to hire an outsider as CEO.

Following the scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is moving to further restrict exports of AI chips, with both Democrats and Republicans voicing support.
A new report warned that sprawling networks of space data centers could make it nearly impossible to stargaze, one of many risks of placing tens of thousands of AI computers into orbit.
Nvidia's leadership crisis continued to evolve, with reports that Jensen Huang might be plotting a return as CEO.

geo: Bessent questioned whether Nvidia 'goosed' earnings with suspect China chip sales.
Congress moved to tighten AI chip export rules after the Nvidia spy scandal.
A new report warned space data centers could end stargazing.
Nvidia's board is reportedly weighing Jensen Huang's return as CEO.
